name: Replace Samsung TV Plus with an app
description: Opens the app set in /opt/usr/share/selfroot/tvplus-replace.conf (APP=<app id>) at power-on, through the TV's own app booting (re-pinned at every boot and shutdown, with an app_launcher fallback) and after every wake from standby (deviced display-state listener), and on the remote's Samsung TV Plus button, through a tvctx-manager key rule (added at boot, removed at shutdown). AUTOSTART=0 or BUTTON=0 turn either part off. Does nothing until APP is set. Pairs with tvplus-off; the TV still flashes 'Not available' on the button because its own TV Plus handler fails. Disable via the manager or the disabled flag.
author: Clément Péron
